svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — In Perth, the race that stops the nation also stops lunch
svg.desc: Black-and-white pen-and-ink editorial cartoon. In a Perth office with a city skyline outside the window, a wall clock shows twelve noon. Office workers freeze to watch the Melbourne Cup on a wall television: a woman in a feathered fascinator cheers with a sweep ticket held high, a man in shirt and tie stops with a sandwich halfway to his open mouth, and a smiling colleague in glasses holds a bowler hat full of sweep tickets at her desk beside a sweep chart on the whiteboard. All characters are fictional.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
IN PERTH, THE RACE THAT STOPS THE NATION ALSO STOPS LUNCH.
Source: ABC News, 2 November 2026 — the Melbourne Cup starts at 3pm AEDT on Tuesday, which is 12 noon in Perth.
